# 7 Star Clean Service

> Family-owned cleaning business based in Lawson, ACT, cleaning Canberra homes and workplaces since October 2016: house, regular, end of lease, carpet steam, office and warehouse cleaning, north and south of the lake. Every job gets a fixed-price quote before work starts.

## Business details

- Name: 7 Star Clean Service
- Based in: Lawson ACT 2617
- Phone: 0431 488 693
- Email: info@7starclean.com.au
- Hours: Mon–Fri 7:00 am – 5:00 pm (Canberra time)
- Website: https://www.7starclean.com.au/
- Google Maps listing: https://maps.google.com/?cid=2021936114814286217
- Google rating when this file was built: 5.0 from 34 Google reviews
- Police-checked cleaners; GST registered; own products and equipment, and the products are eco-friendly.

## Services

- [House cleaning](https://www.7starclean.com.au/services/house-cleaning/): House cleaning in Canberra: regular, one-off and deep cleans by police-checked cleaners. Oven and window add-ons. Fixed price before we start.
- [Regular cleaning](https://www.7starclean.com.au/services/regular-cleaning/): Weekly or fortnightly house cleaning in Canberra with the same cleaners each visit. Police-checked, eco-friendly products, a fixed price per visit.
- [End of lease cleaning](https://www.7starclean.com.au/services/end-of-lease-cleaning/): End of lease and bond cleaning in Canberra to the agent’s checklist, with a bond-back guarantee. Carpet steam cleaning add-on. Fixed-price quote.
- [Carpet steam cleaning](https://www.7starclean.com.au/services/carpet-cleaning/): Carpet cleaning in Canberra by hot water extraction (steam cleaning) for carpets, rugs, couches and mattresses, pet stains included. Fixed price.
- [Office & commercial cleaning](https://www.7starclean.com.au/services/office-cleaning/): Office and commercial cleaning in Canberra for offices, strata and gyms, on a schedule agreed with you. Offices cleaned in Mitchell, Fyshwick and Civic.
- [Warehouse cleaning](https://www.7starclean.com.au/services/warehouse-cleaning/): Warehouse and industrial cleaning in Canberra: floors, amenities and site offices, at times agreed with you. Police-checked cleaners, fixed-price quote.

## End of lease bond-back guarantee

If the agent raises a cleaning issue after an end of lease clean, we come back and fix it at no charge.

## Areas we clean

All of Canberra, north and south of the lake.
